title: Identification of myo-inositol-binding proteins by using the biotin pull-down strategy in cultured cells
protocol: Seal and heat the suspension of 180 mg of inositol (1 mmol), 258 mg biotin methyl (1 mmol) and 11 mg of sodium methoxide (0.2 mmol) in dry N,N-Dimethylformamide (DMF) (6 mL) in a microwave vial with a magnetic stir bar.
Irradiate the reaction mixture at 180°C using maximum power (250 W) for 30 min.
Cool to 50°C with gas jet cooling.
Transfer the reaction mixture to a round-bottomed flask (20 mL).
Culture PC3 cells in RPMI-1640 medium supplied with 10% (V/V) FBS and 2 mM glutamine until confluency reaches 90%.
Harvest PC3 cells from 15 cm dishes once cell confluency is reached.
Incubate cell lysates on ice for 20 min after adding lysis buffer.
Quantify protein concentration using the Bio-Rad Protein Assay Dye Reagent Concentrate.
Centrifuge cell lysates at 4°C for 20 minutes using 16,800 g.
Collect the supernatant in fresh tubes placed on ice.
Subject protein extract to Bio-Rad Protein Assay to quantify protein concentration according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Store Bio-Rad Protein Assay Dye Reagent Concentrate at 4°C for up to 1 year.
Wash Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1 with lab-prepared PBS and binding buffer in advance.
Pre-clear the samples with plain beads to reduce non-specific binding and minimize co-purification of off-target molecules.
Prepare 30 μL of Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1 for each experimental group.
Calculate the total volume of beads including an extra sample to account for loss during washing.
Wash the beads with lab-prepared PBS three times.
Resuspend washed beads in lysis buffer at a ratio of 30 μL per sample plus one additional sample.
Aliquot 30 μL of resuspended beads into fresh tubes.
Add 1 mg of protein extracts to each tube containing Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1.
Fill up the rest of the volume with binding buffer until reaching 500–800 μL per sample.
Incubate the mixture at 4°C for 30 minutes on a rotating wheel at 20 rpm in a vertical position.
Separate protein extracts from beads using a magnetic rack.
Collect pre-clearing protein extracts into fresh tubes on ice.
Prepare 30 μL of Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1 for each experimental group.
Calculate the total volume of beads based on the number of samples plus one extra sample.
Wash the total beads with lab prepared PBS three times.
Resuspend washed beads in 30 μL X (number of samples + 1) of lab prepared PBS and aliquot 30 μL into fresh tubes.
Add 25 μM–40 μM of biotin or biotin-labeled inositol to each tube with beads.
Fill up the rest of volume until 500 μL using lab prepared PBS.
Incubate biotin or biotin-labeled inositol with Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1 for 30 min at 25°C on a rotating wheel.
Collect beads bound to biotin or biotin-inositol using a magnetic rack.
Wash the collected beads three times with lab prepared PBS.
Add pre-clearing 1 mg of protein extracts and incubate with the beads for 2–3 h at 4°C on a rotating wheel.
Spin down each sample at 2,400 g to ensure no beads are left on the cap of tubes.
Separate beads from protein extracts using a magnetic rack.
Remove protein extracts from each tube after separation.
Wash the beads three times with lysis buffer for 30 s and subsequently with lab prepared PBS for 30 s at 4°C.
Add 30 μL of 2× SDS loading dye to each sample.
Boil each sample at 95°C for 5 min.
Dilute 5 times SDS loading dye to prepare 2 times SDS loading dye.
Store the prepared SDS loading dye at −20°C for up to one year.
Load 10 μg of protein extracts as input and 30 μL of each experimental sample onto a gel.
Run protein extracts in a 12% SDS-PAGE gel.
Transfer proteins from the SDS-PAGE gel to a PVDF membrane using Mini Trans-Blot Electrophoretic Transfer Cell under 90 volts for 3 hours.
Conduct PVDF membrane blocking with 3% (W/V) skim milk PBST for 1 hour.
Incubate membranes overnight at 4°C with primary antibodies such as AMPKα, AMPKβ and AMPKγ antibodies.
Wash the membranes three times with PBST for 7 minutes each time.
Incubate membranes with HRP-conjugated secondary antibodies for 1 hour at 25°C.
Wash the membranes three times again with PBST for 7 minutes each time.
Incubate membranes with ECL western blotting substrate for 2 minutes at 25°C.
Visualize signals on autoradiography films.
Incubate cell lysates from PC3 cells with 25 μM of biotin-labeled inositol.
Pull down the mixture using Dynabeads Streptavidin.
Wash the beads to remove unbound proteins.
Immunoblot the pulled-down proteins using specific AMPKα, AMPKβ, and AMPKγ antibodies.
Express full-length recombinant proteins of GST, GST-AMPKα1, GST-AMPKβ1 or GST-AMPKγ1 in Escherichia coli BL21.
Purify recombinant proteins using glutathione-sepharose beads (GE Healthcare, Cat#17-0756-01).
Dilute purified proteins with 10 mM Tris pH 8.0 buffer.
Assess the purity of the recombinant proteins by SDS-PAGE and Coomassie blue staining.
Prepare 30 μL of Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1 for each experimental group.
Wash beads using lab-prepared PBS for 30 seconds, repeating three times.
Resuspend washed beads in binding buffer to a volume of X (number of samples + 1) × 30 μL.
Aliquot 30 μL of resuspended beads into fresh tubes.
Add 100-200 ng of recombinant proteins to each tube with beads.
Fill up the rest of the volume in each tube with binding buffer until reaching 500 μL.
Incubate protein extracts with Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1 for 30 minutes at 4°C on a rotating wheel.
Separate protein extracts from beads using a magnetic rack.
Collect pre-clearing recombinant proteins in fresh tubes and place them on ice.
Prepare 30 μL of new Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1 for each experimental group after washing with lab prepared PBS 30 s each time for 3 times.
Add 25–40 μM of biotin or biotin-labeled inositol in each tube with beads and use lab prepared PBS to fill up the rest of volume until 500 μL.
Incubate biotin or biotin-labeled inositol with Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1 for 30 min at 25°C in a rotating wheel.
Use a magnetic rack to collect beads that bind with biotin or biotin-inositol and then wash beads by lab prepared PBS 30 s each time for 3 times.
Add pre-clearing 100–200 ng of recombinant proteins to incubate with the beads binding with biotin or biotin-labeled inositol, followed by incubating with beads for 1–2 h at 4°C in a rotating wheel.
Spin down each sample to ensure no beads are left on the cap of tubes and then use a magnetic rack to separate beads and protein extracts.
After beads incubate with recombinant proteins, wash beads by wash buffer 30 s each time for 3 times and lab prepared PBS 30 s each time for 3 times at 4°C.
Add 30 μL of 2 times SDS loading dye in each sample after removing lab prepared PBS.
Boil each sample at 95°C for 5 min.
Conduct Western blotting by loading 10 ng of recombinant proteins as input.
Load 30 μL of each experimental sample onto the gel.
Run recombinant proteins with SDS loading dye on a 12% SDS-PAGE.
Transfer protein from SDS-PAGE to PVDF membrane using Mini Trans-Blot Electrophoretic Transfer Cell under 90 V for 3 h.
Conduct membrane blocking by incubating with 3% skim milk for 1 h at room temperature.
Incubate the membrane with primary GST antibody for 3 h at 25°C.
Wash membranes with PBST (PBS+1% Tween 20) for 7 min each time, repeating three times.
Incubate the membrane with HRP-conjugated secondary antibody for 1 h at 25°C.
Wash membranes with PBST (PBS+1% Tween 20) for 7 min each time, repeating three times.
Incubate ECL western blotting substrate with each membrane for 2 min at 25°C.
Visualize signal on the autoradiography films.
Treat 25–40 μM of biotin or biotin-labeled inositol for 1–2 h in PC3 cells.
Culture PC3 cells at 90% confluency in RPMI-1640 medium with 10% FBS and 2 mM glutamine.
Harvest cells using lysis buffer (50 mM Tris pH7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.1% SDS, 0.5% sodium deoxycholate, 1% NP-40, and 1 mM EDTA).
Incubate cell lysates on ice for 20 min.
Centrifuge cell lysates at full speed (16,800 g) for 20 min.
Collect supernatant in fresh tubes placed on ice.
Quantify protein concentration using Bio-Rad Protein Assay.
Prepare 30 μL of Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1 for each experimental group after washing with PBS three times.
Add 1 mg of protein extracts to 30 μL of Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1.
Fill up volume to 500 μL using lysis buffer.
Incubate protein extracts with beads at 4°C in a rotating wheel for 2–3 h.
Wash beads three times with lysis buffer and PBS each.
Conduct Western blotting by loading 10 μg of protein extracts as input.
Load 30 μL of each experimental sample for Western blotting.
Bind 25–40 μM biotin or biotin-labeled inositol to Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1.
Add 1 mg of protein extracts or 100-200 ng of recombinant proteins with beads and fill up the rest of volume until 500 μL using binding buffer.
Add 2.5–4 mM unlabeled myo-inositol to the beads bound to biotin-labeled inositol.
Incubate beads, protein extracts/recombinant proteins, and unlabeled myo-inositol for 1-2 hours at 4°C on a rotating wheel.
Wash beads with lysis buffer three times (30 s each).
Wash beads with wash buffer three times (30 s each) if binding to recombinant proteins; otherwise, proceed directly to washing with PBS three times (30 s each).
Remove the final PBS and add 30 μL of 2x SDS loading dye.
Boil samples at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Incubate cell lysates from PC3 cells with 40 μM biotin, 40 μM biotin-labeled inositol (Biotin-Ins), or 4 mM unlabeled myo-inositol (Ins).
Pulldown inositol-interacting proteins using streptavidin beads.
Subject pulldown samples to immunoblotting with specific AMPKα, AMPKβ, and AMPKγ antibodies.
Incubate GST-AMPKγ1 with 40 μM biotin, 40 μM biotin-labeled inositol (Biotin-Ins), or 4 mM unlabeled myo-inositol (Ins) for 2 hours.
Pulldown the interaction using streptavidin beads.
Determine the interaction by immunoblotting with GST antibody.
